plan.title: Annual Donation Summary
plan.subtitle: Key metrics and trends for this year's donations

panels.title: Total children
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM donor_transactions WHERE Date >= '2023-01-01' AND Date < '2024-01-01'

panels.title: Average score by site
panels.sql: SELECT site AS "site", AVG(score) AS avg_score FROM donor_transactions GROUP BY site ORDER BY avg_score DESC

panels.title: Monthly trend
panels.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, SUM(Amount) AS total FROM donor_transactions WHERE Date >= '2023-01-01' AND Date < '2024-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

panels.title: Top 10 donors
panels.sql: SELECT Donor, SUM(Amount) AS total_amount FROM donor_transactions WHERE Date >= '2023-01-01' AND Date < '2024-01-01' GROUP BY Donor ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: This dashboard provides a concise overview of our donation activity for the current year. The total children metric reflects the number of beneficiaries supported through our programs. Average score by site highlights performance variations across different locations, while the monthly trend chart visualizes donation patterns throughout the year. The top donors table identifies our most significant contributors, enabling targeted appreciation efforts.
